featured.title: Pichai's Google Ran Out of GPUs. So It's Paying a Rocket Company $920 Million a Month.
featured.excerpt: Google capped Meta's Gemini access, leased compute from SpaceX, and still can't keep up with demand. The AI infrastructure crisis is no longer hypothetical.
featured.image_caption: Sundar Pichai, CEO of Alphabet and Google, at a 2023 event
featured.nri_angle: Sundar Pichai's compute crunch directly affects Indian engineers at Google Cloud and Meta, and downstream capacity for Indian IT firms building on Gemini Enterprise.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Wall Street Is Buying India Again. The Market Just Overtook Taiwan and South Korea.
news.excerpt: After pulling $27 billion from Indian stocks this year, global fund managers are reversing course as oil collapses and the rupee recovers — pushing India's market cap back above $5 trillion and past two AI-boom darlings.
news.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai
news.nri_angle: NRI investors who stayed in India through the selloff are seeing portfolios recover, and the rupee's rebound means dollar-denominated returns are finally turning positive again.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Russia Now Supplies More Than Half of India's Oil. June Was the Biggest Month Yet.
news.excerpt: Indian refiners imported a record 2.7 million barrels a day of Russian crude in June — more than double the level from a year ago — as the Hormuz crisis forced them to find alternatives to Middle Eastern supply.
news.image_caption: An oil tanker at an Indian port — Russia now supplies more than half of India's crude imports
news.nri_angle: India's deepening oil dependence on Russia shapes the geopolitical calculations that affect everything from fuel prices at home to the diplomatic tightrope NRIs watch New Delhi walk between Washington and Moscow.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Just Doubled Its Sovereign Infrastructure Bet to ₹60,000 Crore. Here's Where the Money Is Going.
news.excerpt: The Modi cabinet's fresh ₹30,000 crore commitment to NIIF will anchor a successor infrastructure fund backed by Abu Dhabi, Canada, and Singapore — and it's designed to pull in multiples more from global institutions.
news.image_caption: The Bandra-Worli Sea Link in Mumbai, one of India's landmark modern infrastructure projects
news.nri_angle: Government-anchored infrastructure capital flowing into roads, ports, energy, and digital networks directly benefits NRI investors with exposure to Indian markets, and the NIIF model — where Abu Dhabi, Canada, and Singapore co-invest alongside the Indian government — signals investable-grade infrastructure underwritten at the sovereign level.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Delhi Just Banned New Petrol Scooters From 2028. The EV Mandate That Takes Effect Tomorrow Will Reshape India's Biggest Auto Market.
news.excerpt: Starting July 1, electric cars under ₹30 lakh get full tax exemptions in Delhi. By 2028, new petrol two-wheelers won't be registered at all. ₹15,000 crore in investment is expected to follow.
news.image_caption: An electric vehicle charging station in India, part of the country's growing EV infrastructure network
news.nri_angle: NRIs visiting Delhi will encounter the EV transition firsthand, those with family there will navigate the mandates, and investors in Indian auto stocks like Tata Motors, Mahindra, Ather, and Ola Electric now have regulatory certainty backing what was previously a demand-driven bet.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Tax Revolution Enters Year 10 — and the Next Phase Is Being Built by Machines
news.excerpt: GST 2.0 is shifting from digitisation to AI-driven enforcement, database integration and a two-tier rate structure that has already lifted business confidence to near-universal levels
news.image_caption: India's new Parliament building in New Delhi, where the GST Council continues to shape the country's evolving indirect tax framework
news.image_credit: Government of India, GODL-India, via Wikimedia Commons
news.nri_angle: NRI entrepreneurs running businesses in India benefit from GST's unified tax framework, which eliminated multi-state tax complexity. E-invoicing, AI-driven compliance, and streamlined refunds reduce paperwork for diaspora-owned MSMEs. A formalised economy with 1.6 crore registered taxpayers also improves transparency for NRI investors.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Your Indian Bank Can No Longer Sneak Insurance Into Your Home Loan. The RBI's Mis-Selling Crackdown Starts Tomorrow.
news.excerpt: New rules effective July 1 require banks to prove customers understood and chose every product they were sold — with refunds and compensation if they didn't
news.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai, where the new consumer protection framework was drafted
news.image_credit: A.Savin, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
news.nri_angle: NRIs with Indian bank accounts have been frequent targets of mis-selling, particularly insurance products bundled with loans and deposit renewals. The new RBI framework gives NRIs and their families a concrete refund and compensation mechanism when banks cannot prove informed, voluntary consent.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: 200 Indian Americans Walked Into 125 Congressional Offices in One Day. Here's What They Asked For.
news.excerpt: The fourth annual FIIDS Capitol Hill Day tripled its inaugural turnout, pressing lawmakers on green card reform, critical minerals, and the US-India defence corridor.
news.image_caption: The west front of the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C.
news.nri_angle: Indian Americans are turning economic influence into legislative power — pressing Congress directly on green card backlogs, H-1B reform, and the issues that shape diaspora life.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The Pentagon Just Cleared Half a Billion Dollars to Keep India's Apaches and Howitzers Battle-Ready
news.excerpt: Two new support packages worth $482 million cover spare parts, training, and maintenance for American-made attack helicopters and artillery — the unsexy work that keeps a $20 billion defence relationship alive.
news.image_caption: A Boeing AH-64D Apache Longbow attack helicopter, the same type operated by the Indian Air Force
news.nri_angle: Defence deals underpin the US-India strategic corridor that shapes visa policy, trade access, and the diplomatic weight behind every Indian professional's presence in America.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Just Raised Passport Fees by Up to 67%. The New Rates Hit Tomorrow.
news.excerpt: A standard 36-page passport now costs ₹2,500, up from ₹1,500. Replacing a lost one under Tatkal will set you back ₹8,500. Here's the full breakdown — and what NRIs applying through missions abroad should know.
news.image_caption: An Indian passport in a leather travel wallet — fees for renewals and fresh applications rise sharply from July 1
news.nri_angle: NRIs renewing passports or applying for children's passports through Indian missions abroad face higher fees starting July 1, with costs rising by up to 67% for standard applications and even more for lost passport replacements.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Indian Families Sold 50 Tonnes of Gold Last Quarter. It’s the Biggest Sell-Off in Years.
news.excerpt: Fearing prices could crater to ₹1.2 lakh per 10 grams, households are ditching heirloom jewellery for cold, hard cash — and India’s gold recycling industry is booming.
news.image_caption: Gold bullion bars. Indian households sold nearly 50 tonnes of old gold in the April-June quarter, a 43% year-on-year surge driven by fears of further price declines.
news.nri_angle: NRIs holding family gold in India face the same price correction dynamics. The sell-off signals a generational shift from treating gold as untouchable heirloom to tradable financial asset — a conversation many overseas Indians are having with family back home.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Lifts Emergency Fuel Restrictions Starting July 1 as Oil Prices Collapse
news.excerpt: The 200-litre diesel cap and ban on commercial buyers at retail pumps are gone. Brent crude has fallen 42% from its April peak, and windfall taxes are being reshuffled.
news.image_caption: A Hindustan Petroleum fuel pump in India. Emergency restrictions on diesel and petrol sales at retail outlets will be lifted on July 1.
news.nri_angle: NRI-owned businesses in transport, manufacturing, and agriculture were directly impacted by the fuel restrictions. The episode highlights India’s energy import vulnerability and the speed at which Middle East conflicts ripple into everyday fuel access.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The Supreme Court Just Told 250,000 Babies a Year They're Still American. Here's What It Means for H-1B Families.
news.excerpt: In a 6-3 ruling on the final day of its term, the court struck down Trump's executive order restricting birthright citizenship — a case that had Indian professionals on temporary visas watching closer than anyone.
news.image_caption: The Supreme Court of the United States in Washington, D.C.
news.nri_angle: Indian H-1B holders — the largest group of temporary work visa holders in the US — were directly in the crosshairs of Trump's executive order, which would have stripped US citizenship from their American-born children.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: He Called India's Jobless Youth 'Cockroaches.' They Built a Party Around It.
news.excerpt: The Cockroach Janta Party has 22 million followers, a Boston University graduate at the helm, and an icon of Ladakh on hunger strike at its side. India's education minister may not survive the week.
news.image_caption: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk, who began an indefinite hunger strike at Jantar Mantar on June 28
news.nri_angle: The NEET exam scandal directly affects NRI families with children in India's education pipeline, and the movement is led by a Boston University graduate who flew back from the US to organise protests.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: He Filed 64 Identical Asylum Claims for Indian Clients. ICE Just Made Him the First Attorney It's Ever Fined for It.
news.excerpt: California-based Vinod Doddamani faces a $255,000 penalty in a first-of-its-kind crackdown on immigration attorneys. For the Indian diaspora, the fallout goes far beyond one case.
news.image_caption: The ICE headquarters building in Washington, D.C. — the agency issued its first-ever attorney fine in a crackdown on fraudulent asylum claims (Wikimedia Commons / CC BY 3.0)
news.nri_angle: Indian nationals are disproportionately affected by asylum fraud crackdowns, which can tighten scrutiny on all Indian immigration applicants and feed anti-immigrant narratives that shape H-1B and green card policy.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Spent 17% More in Two Months but Used Less Than a Tenth of Its Deficit Budget. Here's How.
news.excerpt: Fresh government data shows India's April-May fiscal deficit at just 9.6% of its full-year target — down sharply from the alarming 21% burn rate a month earlier. The capex push is real, and so are the risks.
news.image_caption: The Central Secretariat in New Delhi, seat of India's federal government
news.nri_angle: India's fiscal discipline directly impacts bond yields, rupee stability, and the investment climate that NRIs and diaspora investors are betting on — the record $3B foreign bond inflows in June are downstream of these numbers.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Apple Calls India's Antitrust Case Against It 'Copy-Pasted.' The Regulator Has Heard That Before.
news.excerpt: In its sharpest filing yet, Apple accuses the CCI of lifting rivals' claims verbatim instead of running its own investigation. Google tried the same argument — and lost.
news.image_caption: Apple Park, the company's headquarters in Cupertino, California
news.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech professionals at Apple and Google face scrutiny of their employers' practices, while Indian startups like PhonePe and Paytm push for fairer app store rules that could reshape India's digital economy.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The Rupee Just Posted Its First Quarterly Gain in Over a Year. Here's What It Took.
news.excerpt: Oil's 42% crash, a record $3 billion bond surge, and a Goldman Sachs upgrade pulled India's currency back from the brink. NRI wallets feel the difference.
news.image_caption: Indian rupee banknotes — the currency posted its first quarterly gain since early 2025
news.nri_angle: The rupee's quarterly gain directly affects the purchasing power of remittances sent by 18 million NRIs, while RBI measures offering up to 7.5% on FCNR deposits create the most attractive NRI inflow proposition in years.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Won't Sign the US Trade Deal Until It Gets a Better Rate Than Pakistan. That's Not Happening Anytime Soon.
news.excerpt: After the Supreme Court struck down Trump's sweeping tariffs, the 18% deal that looked generous in February now looks like a bad bargain. Commerce Minister Goyal says the agreement is frozen until Washington fixes the math.
news.image_caption: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal at a government event
news.nri_angle: A stalled India-US trade deal affects professional services provisions, business visa terms, and the broader diplomatic climate that shapes Indian American daily life.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: The Diaspora's Highest-Ranking AI Voice in Washington Just Walked Out of the White House
nri-world.excerpt: Sriram Krishnan's six-month run as Trump's senior AI policy adviser ends today. He's not done with Washington — he's just changing the address.
nri-world.image_caption: Sriram Krishnan, who served as senior White House AI policy adviser
nri-world.nri_angle: Krishnan's trajectory from Chennai to the West Wing represents a new frontier for Indian-American influence — policy, not just corporate leadership — and his departure raises the question of who fills the gap.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: He Sent ₹11 Lakh to His Parents. India's Tax Department Took Six Years to Believe It Was a Gift.
nri-world.excerpt: A US-based NRI's routine family transfer turned into a protracted legal battle. The case is a masterclass in what every diaspora family sending money home gets wrong.
nri-world.image_caption: Tax documents and a smartphone on a desk — the kind of paperwork NRIs ignore at their peril
nri-world.nri_angle: Millions of NRIs send money to family in India every year with minimal documentation. This case shows exactly how that can go wrong — and what to do about it.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Modi and Carney Have Met Four Times in Under a Year. Here's What India and Canada Just Agreed To.
nri-world.excerpt: A C$2.6 billion uranium deal, a defence pact, a free trade agreement by December, and 300 research scholarships — the India-Canada relationship has turned around so fast that neither side seems sure what to do with the momentum.
nri-world.image_caption: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, who has met PM Modi four times in under a year
nri-world.nri_angle: Canada is home to 1.8 million Indian-origin people — the diplomatic reset directly affects visa processing, education pathways, business opportunities, and community safety for the largest Indian diaspora outside the US.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Five Indian Americans, Five Fields, One State: Inside GOPIO-CT's 20th Anniversary Honours
nri-world.excerpt: A state senator, a nanotech founder, a journalist, a bank CEO, and an engineering professor — Connecticut's diaspora organisation celebrated two decades by showcasing the community's breadth.
nri-world.image_caption: Indian Americans celebrating community achievements — GOPIO-CT has been building diaspora institutions in Connecticut for two decades (Wikimedia Commons)
nri-world.nri_angle: GOPIO-CT's 20th anniversary banquet in Darien honoured five Indian American leaders spanning politics, biotech, journalism, banking, and engineering — illustrating the community's growing institutional depth and bipartisan political standing in the American Northeast.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: The Rate War for NRI Dollars: Indian Banks Are Offering Up to 7.5% on Foreign Currency Deposits
nri-world.excerpt: The RBI removed interest rate ceilings and is subsidising hedging costs until September 30. Banks have responded with the most aggressive FCNR repricing in years. Here's what it means for your money.
nri-world.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai, which triggered a bank-level rate war with its June FCNR policy changes
nri-world.nri_angle: A practical guide for NRIs weighing the best FCNR deposit rates after the RBI's unprecedented June 2026 policy changes — comparing bank-by-bank offers, tax treatment, lock-in terms, and the September 30 deadline that makes this a limited-time opportunity.

nri-world.title: Indian Passport Fees Jump Up to 75% From July 1. Here’s What Changes for NRIs.
nri-world.excerpt: The Ministry of External Affairs has revised passport charges across the board — fresh applications, renewals, Tatkaal, and replacements all cost more. With 32 million overseas Indians, the timing is hard to ignore.
nri-world.image_caption: An Indian passport. Fee revisions notified by the Ministry of External Affairs take effect on July 1, 2026.
nri-world.nri_angle: India's 32 million overseas Indians rely on passport services for travel, residency, and legal identity. The fee hike affects Gulf renewals, family applications, and consular services worldwide. Paired with broader July 1 financial changes including ITR deadline shifts and credit card reporting rules.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Belfast Burned. An Indian Woman Fed the Families Left Behind.
nri-world.excerpt: Anti-immigration riots in Northern Ireland displaced dozens of minority families. For the Indian community in the UK, the violence has deepened a quiet unease about safety that no advisory can fully address.
nri-world.image_caption: Belfast City Hall, Donegall Square — the heart of a city shaken by anti-immigration violence in June 2026. (Wikimedia Commons)
nri-world.nri_angle: The Belfast riots forced Indians and other ethnic minorities in Northern Ireland to confront their vulnerability. Ruchira Rangaprasad's community meal drive and INSIGHT UK's safety advisory for Hindu communities reflect a diaspora learning to protect itself in an increasingly hostile European landscape.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: The Diaspora's Philanthropy Machine Just Turned 25. It Raised a Record $3.8 Million in One Night.
nri-world.excerpt: The American India Foundation's silver-jubilee gala honoured BNY, Bharat Masrani and Salil Parekh — and marked a turning point for Indian-American giving that has nearly tripled in six years.
nri-world.image_caption: Bharat Masrani, retired CEO of TD Bank Group, was honoured at AIF's 25th-anniversary gala at Cipriani Wall Street
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-American philanthropy has reached an inflection point, with giving tripling to $4–5 billion and the gap between potential and actual donations shrinking to $1 billion. AIF's gala channels that energy into education, health and livelihoods across India.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: She Built the Middleware That Moves Indian Brands Across Borders. EY Just Noticed.
nri-world.excerpt: Somdutta Singh becomes the third and youngest Indian woman to win an EY Entrepreneur Of The Year award, after Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw and Falguni Nayar.
nri-world.image_caption: Somdutta Singh, founder and CEO of Assiduus, is just the third Indian woman to win the EY Entrepreneur Of The Year Southeast award (Wikimedia Commons)
nri-world.nri_angle: Singh's cross-border commerce platform is the infrastructure layer NRIs and Indian exporters depend on. Her recognition at a global entrepreneurship award elevates the visibility of Indian women founders in the diaspora business landscape.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: An Indian Law Graduate Just Became CFO of America's Biggest Gym Chain. He Also Runs Its Global Expansion.
nri-world.excerpt: Planet Fitness appoints Sudhanshu Priyadarshi — a National Law School alumnus who has steered finances at Keurig, PepsiCo, and Walmart — as CFO and President, International.
nri-world.image_caption: A Planet Fitness location in Ypsilanti Township, Michigan — part of the chain's 2,700-strong network that Priyadarshi now helps steer
nri-world.nri_angle: Priyadarshi's appointment at Planet Fitness extends the growing pattern of Indian-origin executives reaching the C-suite of major American consumer brands, normalising a career trajectory that was rare a generation ago.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: The App the Diaspora Lives On Just Got an Indian Boss
nri-world.excerpt: Kunal Shah, who built CRED from a million dollars of personal capital into a $4.5 billion fintech, will lead WhatsApp globally — the clearest sign yet that Meta's future runs through India.
nri-world.image_caption: Kunal Shah, founder of CRED and the new global head of WhatsApp
nri-world.nri_angle: WhatsApp is the communication backbone of virtually every diaspora family — the morning prayers forwarded from Ahmedabad, the group chat that settles who is cooking for the potluck, the voice notes that keep grandparents present across oceans. An Indian founder now runs it.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India's Tall Ship Has Sailed 13,000 Miles to Help America Celebrate Its Birthday. The Diaspora Turned Out to Watch.
nri-world.excerpt: INS Sudarshini's five-month voyage from Kochi to Baltimore — with stops in Oman, Egypt, France, and the Canary Islands — culminates in community outreach events that have drawn Indian Americans across the mid-Atlantic.
nri-world.image_caption: INS Sudarshini under sail during a previous transoceanic voyage
nri-world.nri_angle: The ship's community outreach events in Norfolk and Baltimore draw Indian Americans from across the mid-Atlantic corridor — one of the largest concentrations of the diaspora in the US — offering a rare moment of visible Indian presence in a quintessentially American celebration.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs with bank deposits, mutual fund SIPs, and exposure to Indian financial stocks, the RBI's clean bill of health for the banking system is directly reassuring — but the risks flagged deserve equal attention.

markets-finance.excerpt: Oil's 42% crash from $126 to $73, a barrage of RBI measures, and $2.4 billion in net foreign inflows helped the rupee recover from record lows near 97 to settle around 94.66 — but the Fed's hawkish tilt and a weak monsoon cloud the outlook.

markets-finance.nri_angle: The rupee's recovery directly affects NRI remittances, SIP values, and NRE deposit returns — and the RBI's FCNR window at 7.5% offers a time-limited opportunity for diaspora investors.

markets-finance.excerpt: The Nifty IT index fell 9.6% in June as Accenture's guidance cut, AI cannibalization fears, and Middle East demand shocks converged into a perfect storm for the $315 billion sector that employs millions of NRIs.

markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs who work in IT services, hold IT stocks, or whose H-1B careers depend on the sector face employment risk, investment losses, and visa pipeline uncertainty as AI disruption and demand weakness converge.

markets-finance.title: Foreign Investors Just Poured a Record $3 Billion Into Indian Bonds in a Single Month — and the Biggest Catalyst Is Still Ahead
markets-finance.excerpt: India's historic decision to scrap all taxes on foreign bond investments has triggered the largest monthly inflow ever under the Fully Accessible Route, with Bloomberg Global Aggregate Index inclusion now firmly on the horizon.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI investors holding or considering Indian government bonds stand to benefit from the tax exemptions and rising foreign demand, while RBI measures to boost dollar inflows are simultaneously improving FCNR deposit rates and rupee stability.

markets-finance.excerpt: The appointment of Rajiv Kumar, who once froze 3.38 lakh shell company accounts and led the merger of 27 public sector banks into 12, signals a governance reset at India's largest private lender after its previous chairman quit citing ethical concerns.

markets-finance.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is the most widely held Indian stock among NRI investors — the new chairman's track record of cleaning up banking governance directly affects the governance premium that overseas shareholders pay for India's largest private lender.

markets-finance.nri_angle: This is a direct, time-limited opportunity for NRIs to earn 6-7.5% on dollar deposits in India with no currency risk — a rare combination that may not repeat for years.

sports.title: Mbappé Scores Twice. France Demolish Sweden 3-0 and He's Now One Goal From Messi's All-Time Record.

sports.image_caption: Kylian Mbappé during France's World Cup 2026 group stage match against Senegal
